operations.title: Nima closes the cosmological deck-transfer admission gate
operations.body: Source audit closes the physical admission gate narrowly. Entries 1223-1225 provide equivariant chamber transport and the diagonal coefficient–Betti pairing, but no quotient cover, forgetting map, or chain pushforward. Entry 1224’s only orbit trace explicitly changes the frozen observable. Therefore the finite fiber-sum transfer remains algebraically canonical but is not presently a cosmological physical constructor. A future admission requires a source-derived map of relative pairs with oriented pushforward, boundary compatibility, and chamber normalization. Packet: research/nima/cosmology-deck-transfer-admission-gate.md; graph event 1125.
